artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene with a lively interaction among animals and objects. The illustration includes a small dog at the center of the scene. Objects are scattered on the floor, and birds perch on a suspended rod. Earthenware pots are visible, and the open window shows architectural structures in the distance.

artworks.title: Belphegor
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This image depicts a detailed domestic interior with various objects and animals. The room features shelves holding pottery items, and a window showing a city landscape. Two birds are perched at the window, and objects like a basket, spool of thread, and small pen are on the floor. In the center, a small dog is present, adding life to the scene. The drawing emphasizes texture and depth through etching lines and shading techniques.

artworks.description: The image depicts two human figures interacting in dense foliage. One figure is a bull. The setting is a forest with intricate line work showing detailed textures. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: La clochette
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a pastoral scene with a cow and two figures. The scene depicts a dynamic moment where a cow appears to be moving toward two figures. The figures are captured in motion; the one in the foreground seems to be running while carrying another. The surroundings are dense with trees and foliage, rendered with intricate detail. The scene conveys a sense of urgency and movement, as indicated by the flowing clothes and the posture of the figures.

artworks.title: Le glouton
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jacques Louis François Touzé
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene. The room is ornately decorated with elegant wall designs, including a prominent central emblem depicting a harp with wings. Several figures are positioned around a table covered with a white cloth, with various objects on the table. Sculptural elements are visible in the adjacent room through an open door, allowing light to pour into the space. The floor features a patterned design with shadows adding depth to the setting.

artworks.title: Le glouton
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jacques Louis François Touzé
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals gathered around a table in a room. The table is covered with a cloth and various objects, including a plate of food. The figures around the table are depicted engaging with each other through expressive gestures. The room is well-appointed with curtain-draped walls and ornate furniture, and the drawing features intricate details such as patterns on textiles and textures on wood.

artworks.title: Le glouton
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jacques Louis François Touzé
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a room. All the figures are fully visible. One person stands to the left, leaning forward and holding a cane, gesturing towards the table. He has long, curly hair and wears a long coat with a vest and breeches. Next to him, a man with shoulder-length hair is seated at the table, wearing a coat and cravat. His expression appears surprised or concerned as he interacts with the standing man. In the center, a woman is partially reclined over a table covered with a cloth, wearing a headscarf and facing a plate of food. Beside her, another man in a coat and cravat, with lightly curled hair, is stepping back. The room features ornate interior décor, including a large framed emblem or shield on the wall behind them, a draped curtain to the right, and objects on the floor such as a bottle, a plate, and a cushion. The setting suggests an 18th-century atmosphere based on the clothing and furniture style.

artworks.title: Les deux amis
artworks.artist: French 18th Century
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals standing or sitting in an ornate room. One person is seated on an elaborate chair, while the other two individuals stand nearby. The person on the left has curly hair and wears a gown. The person in the middle has short, curly hair and is draped in a cloth that reveals one shoulder. The seated person also has short, curly hair and wears a gown with a distinctive collar. The room features richly patterned drapery, pillars, and a small statue of a winged figure. A table on the left side holds a potted plant and a dish. The floor is adorned with an intricate pattern.

artworks.title: Les deux amis
artworks.artist: French 18th Century
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a classical setting. On the left, a female stands upright wearing a long, draped garment and a wreath in her hair. In the center, a male stands with one hand on the shoulder of the seated male figure. The seated male has shorter, wavier hair and leans back in an ornate chair. The room has large fabric drapes, an intricate chair, a small statue on a pedestal, large columns, and a vessel with plants on a table. The flooring suggests a decorative rug or detailed tile work.

artworks.title: Le juge de mesle

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The composition depicts figures in formal attire engaged in proceedings. The environment includes classical architectural elements like columns and drapery framing the scene. In the upper right corner, there is a seated female figure with scales, an allegorical representation of Justice. The scene is detailed, with emphasis on robes, facial expressions, and a serious tone.

artworks.title: Le juge de mesle
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a court scene. It shows figures in elaborate and formal clothing, engaged in discussion or debate, while others observe. The setting is a grand architectural space with large curtains and classical features like columns and arches. The composition is detailed and portrays movement and tension.

artworks.title: Le juge de mesle
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene with judges and lawyers in discussion. The scene is detailed, showing a dramatic moment with figures in elaborate robes gesturing energetically. One figure appears to preside over the court with a sense of authority. The setting is classical with arched windows and draped curtains. The figures are engrossed in gestures, indicating a lively debate or discussion. The composition directs the viewer's focus to the central action points.

artworks.title: Alix malade
artworks.artist: French 18th Century
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in a robe standing at the entrance of an open doorway on a staircase, pointing with one hand and holding the door with the other. Another individual is on the steps, looking up toward the building while holding an object close to their chest. In the background are lush foliage and a distant archway with another figure present. The drawing features precise lines and minimal shading.

artworks.title: Alix malade
artworks.artist: French 18th Century
artworks.description: The image shows two figures interacting on a stone staircase. One figure stands lower with his body turned slightly away, gesturing with his arm extended backward while holding a hat. He wears period clothing and unkempt long hair. The second figure stands higher, partially turned towards the first figure, wearing a robe and curly hair, with one hand raised and the other holding onto a door. The background features a pastoral setting with trees, mountains, and a small figure near the entrance structure.

artworks.title: Le baiser rendu: Le baiser prete
artworks.artist: G. Mallesteste after Jacques Louis François Touzé
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene set outside a church. The drawing depicts a group of figures in period attire standing near a tree, with an ornate church building in the background. One of the figures appears to be holding a hat, while another seems to be interacting closely with a third figure. A small dog stands by, and various individuals, including one holding a hat or waving in the distance, add to the tableau. The building's architecture is distinguished by gothic elements and a rose window. Surrounding foliage frames the scene, suggesting a setting that is both grand and natural.

artworks.title: Le baiser rendu: Le baiser rendu

artworks.description: Three people are depicted in the image, with a woman in the center standing and holding her dress. A man on her left leans towards her, while another man on her right extends his arm. In the background, there are two additional figures and a person on horseback. A small dog is at the feet of the central figures, with large trees and foliage in the background, along with a partially visible building.

artworks.title: Le baiser rendu: Le baiser rendu
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jacques Louis François Touzé
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals standing closely together on a platform. The person in the center is a woman with curly hair and a long dress. Flanking her are two men in period clothing. One man appears to be whispering in her ear, while the other is reaching out to her. A small dog is near their feet. The background shows lush trees and a stone building with columns. Onlookers, including a child, observe from a distance.

artworks.title: Le baiser rendu: Le baiser rendu
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Jacques Louis François Touzé
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in the center. A woman stands between two men. One man is leaning towards her, the other man is gesturing. The woman wears a long gown, with curly hair. The first man is elaborately dressed, while the second man is wearing a hat, a coat with tails, and holding a stick. A small dog is near them. The background has lush foliage, tall trees, and a partially visible building with two additional figures watching from the right.

artworks.title: Soeur Jeanne
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Charles Monnet
artworks.description: The image shows five women who are nuns. Four of them are sitting and interacting with each other, while one is standing to the right holding a piece of paper. They have serene expressions while wearing traditional wimples and veils, along with flowing gowns. The room they are in is richly decorated with curtains, a chair, an open book on a table, and a small harp. There is also a basket with fabric or yarn on the floor. The background features wood-paneled walls with a relief or frieze depicting clouds and cherubs.

artworks.title: Soeur Jeanne
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Charles Monnet
artworks.description: The image depicts five nuns in a room. Four nuns are sitting around a table with concerned expressions, while one stands beside them. They are dressed in traditional nun attire with headdresses, featuring delicate facial features. The room includes a table with an open book, a cat on a chair, ornate wall detailing, and a basket of bread on the floor.

artworks.title: Soeur Jeanne
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Charles Monnet
artworks.description: The image shows an interior space with five women, possibly nuns. Four women are seated around a table, while the fifth woman stands slightly turned away. Their body language and facial expressions suggest various reactions. They wear traditional habit attire. One woman has an open book on the table, and there is a piece of cloth draped across it. A cat sits on a cushioned chair. The background features a wooden interior with a detailed doorframe and a painting in another room. Luxurious drapery, a basket with items, and an intricate panel on the ceiling complete the setting.

artworks.title: Imitation d'anacreon: Le portrait d'iris
artworks.artist: French 18th Century
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist painting from a live model in a classical interior. The scene depicts a classical interior with an artist painting a portrait of a figure. The artist is seated and appears concentrated on the canvas, capturing an idealized female figure. Adjacent to them is a standing nude statue on a pedestal. The room features antique-style decor like Greco-Roman columns, draped fabrics, and framed artworks on the walls. The furniture includes a table with art-making objects. The drawing is detailed and uses a cross-hatching technique for texture.

artworks.title: Autre imitation: L'amour mouille
artworks.artist: French 18th Century
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man and a young child. The man sits on a chair with his body slightly turned to the side, extending one arm towards the child. He has a full beard, deep-set eyes, curly hair, and is dressed in classical attire. The child stands in front of the man with curly hair, chubby cheeks, and a playful expression. The child is unclothed, and the interior has a classical design with draped fabric, a tall candlestick, a lyre, a swan sculpture, and a brazier with a flaming fire.

artworks.title: L'hermite (Le diable en enfer)
artworks.artist: after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One person is seated, partially covered by fabric, revealing bare legs and upper body. They sit facing the viewer, with feet almost touching the floor. Another person, standing and wearing a long robe, appears to be arranging the fabric over the seated individual. Details of their clothing and appearance are provided. Various textiles, objects, foliage, and an ornate structure are visible in the background.
